name: toast
title: Toast
description: A short message in a corner of the screen that leaves on its own.

props.name: limit
props.description: How many toasts can show at once. Older ones fold away behind the newest.

props.name: timeout
props.description: How long each toast stays, in milliseconds. Hovering keeps it.

parts.name: ToastProvider
parts.description: Wrap your app once. It holds the toasts and draws them in the corner.

parts.name: useToast
parts.description: Returns add, update and close. Call add with a title, a description and a type.
